title: Shape search G1 on its frozen cells (n, l) = (13, 5), (17, 6), (19, 7)
status_note: Blocked on PR #1892 (the ladder binary is on an unmerged branch; the card becomes ready only on a merged commit) and on memory: the frozen cells did not fit the 2.5 GB cap of the run that killed G1 on its scaled cells.
blocked_on: pr:1892 factor_base_shape_ladder and the G1-G6 study (claude/leads-shape-search, open, unmerged); pin its merge commit
hw:degree-7 matrices need 47-50 GB at (13, 5) and more at (17, 6) and (19, 7) (PROTOCOL.md §3 of research/shape_search_g1_g6_20261015); size a host per cell in this card's PROTOCOL.md

notes: research/shape_search_g1_g6_20261015/README.md on branch claude/leads-shape-search (G1 killed on the scaled cells; 'not testable on the frozen cells (resource)')

question: On class-0 targets at m = 3, do the gp and fp factor-base shapes have a mean refutation degree at least 0.5 below random at two of the frozen cells (13, 5), (17, 6), (19, 7), as goal G1 was frozen to ask?
decision_value: G1 is already killed on the scaled cells (gap 0.000 at n = 5, 7, 11), so the prior is a null here too; this card exists because the frozen goal named these cells and they were not testable for resources, which leaves G1's verdict on its own terms open. A gap of >= 0.5 at two frozen cells revives the shape line and gates G6 (n = 31 with the real F4 engine, then the m = 83 gate); no gap closes G1 on its frozen cells and retires the shape builders; a censored result (both arms at the degree bound) closes nothing and says so.

resources.notes: Not estimable from committed data: one random draw at (13, 5), d_max = 6 did not finish in 60 min under a 2.5 GB cap; degree 7 needs 47-50 GB at (13, 5); (17, 6) and (19, 7) have 35 and 40 unknowns, C(35, 6) ~ 1.6e6 and C(40, 6) ~ 3.8e6 degree-6 columns. 64 GB is a floor for (13, 5) only. PROTOCOL.md must size each cell from a timed probe before the card is ready.

params.argv_note: Cell syntax n:l:d_max as in runs/*.meta of the study; output is JSONL on stdout, which cairn lab exec records as the run's stdout blob. Instance and target counts and the dense budget are set in PROTOCOL.md from the probe.

outputs.result_schema: factor_base_shape_ladder g1 JSONL (one line per measured target), scored by `factor_base_shape_ladder score`

cairn.notes: Three single heavy runs, one lab task per cell. Not preemptible (no checkpoint).

env.name: crypto-shape-f12cb92

funding.rationale: Below lead 1 and the P-224 depth check: G1 is already killed on its scaled cells, so this mostly closes a frozen goal on its own terms; still cheaper and more decisive than the P-192 search.
